tools.name: burstsms_list_sms
tools.description: List sent and received SMS messages with delivery status. Filter by date range, sender, recipient, message_ref, or direction. Returns smses, total_records and total_segments.

tools.name: burstsms_get_sms
tools.description: Get one SMS message by its id: recipient, sender, status, segment count and timestamps.

tools.name: burstsms_send_sms
tools.description: Send one SMS to one recipient. This sends a real message that costs account credit and is not reversed. Long messages are split into segments. Add [opt-out-link] in the text to add an opt-out link.

tools.name: burstsms_send_mms
tools.description: Send one MMS with one or more media files (https URLs of jpg, gif, png, mp3 or mp4). This sends a real message that costs account credit and is not reversed.

tools.name: burstsms_get_mms
tools.description: Get one MMS message by its id: recipient, sender, status and timestamps.

tools.name: burstsms_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured on the account. An account can have at most 25.

tools.name: burstsms_get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook by its id: name, URL, filter and rate limit.

tools.name: burstsms_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook that sends JSON events (for example SMS_STATUS or SMS_INBOUND) to an https URL you control. Event data includes phone numbers and message text. An account can have at most 25 webhooks.

tools.name: burstsms_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook by its id. Events stop at once; this cannot be undone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: burstsms_list_sms, burstsms_get_sms, burstsms_get_mms, burstsms_get_webhook · Private data: burstsms_send_mms · Public sink: burstsms_list_sms, burstsms_get_sms, burstsms_send_sms, burstsms_send_mms, burstsms_get_webhook, burstsms_create_webhook, burstsms_delete_webhook · Destructive: burstsms_delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: burstsms_list_sms, burstsms_get_sms, burstsms_get_mms, burstsms_get_webhook · Private data: burstsms_send_mms · Public sink: burstsms_list_sms, burstsms_get_sms, burstsms_send_sms, burstsms_send_mms, burstsms_get_webhook, burstsms_create_webhook, burstsms_delete_webhook · Destructive: burstsms_delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
